reader.changelog: WAren6 Reader v1.7.0 - Stability release with duplicate-message prevention, Reader legacy duplicate hiding, contact and mention fixes, reactions, message ticks, and signed updater metadata.

field_kit.changelog: WAren6 Field Kit v2.0.0 - Major performance and zero-dependency release: in-memory C# page decryption (20x-30x faster), zero pip packages, Windows native CNG AES-NI crypto, native .NET zip compression, and resilient LevelDB iteration.
